AgentV SDK evaluation failed: node: --import tsx is not allowed in NODE_OPTIONS

root_cause: src/slm_training/evals/agentv.py spawned the AgentV node runner without clearing the process's inherited NODE_OPTIONS. This session's container sets NODE_OPTIONS to a value this Node build rejects (--import tsx), so scripts.evaluate_model --ship-gates failed inside publish_agentv_evaluation before any AgentEvals criterion executed, on both arms identically. Both trains completed to their declared 21 steps and wrote local no-sync checkpoints; only evaluation was blocked.
fix: Committed 46fecfc: added _sanitized_env() to src/slm_training/evals/agentv.py (same pattern already used by src/slm_training/dsl/grammar/backends/graphql_js.py) and passed it to the AgentV subprocess.run call; bumped evals.agentv v6->v7; added a regression test; also repaired two test_agentv.py fixtures left stale by the ast_beq_rate/canonical_beq_rate ship-gate criteria that were blocking the pre-commit hook's changed-file test gate.
